access_step_open: Open that file on the server (copy server_config.example.lua first if it is not there).
access_step_paste: Paste your license into the admins list, exactly as shown.

access_subtitle: Add your license below to open Script Studio
admins_config_hint: Set in server_config.lua — remove it there
admins_detail_none: Nothing on record for this identifier
admins_detail_show: Everything we know about this admin
admins_from_server_help: In because your server already trusts them:

admins_roles_help: What each role may open and change
anim_no_data: The animation list could not be loaded
anim_search: Search animations, or a dictionary name
attach_bench_clear_hint: Empty the bench: your own ped, no prop, nothing remembered

attach_example_hint: Load a worked example \u2014 click again for the next one

attach_job_custom: or type a prop model, then Enter

attach_paste_bad: That is not a settings block
attach_ped_model: Ped model — Enter to wear it

attach_vehicle_model: or type a model, then Enter
bridge_dependencies_help: gg_lib will not run without these
bridge_empty: No script has reported a bridge yet
bridge_help: What each script detected, and whether it took
bridge_interface_help: Who draws notifications, progress bars and menus
bridge_pending: Saved — restart gg_lib and your scripts to apply
capture_note: Leave this running -- it is using your camera
capture_stopping: Finishing the one in hand, then stopping
catalogue_image_help: Where item icons load from. Use %s where the file name goes. Leave empty to use the detected inventory.
catalogue_search_hint: Search from the bar above by name or spawn name
catalogue_search_items: Search items by name or label…
catalogue_search_vehicles: Search vehicles by model, name or brand…
customs_need_vehicle_help: The customs editor works on the vehicle you are sitting in, so it always changes the one you meant.
customs_none: This model has nothing in this group

fav_none: Nothing kept yet - star a row to put it here
groups_help: Every crew on the server as it stands right now
groups_none: No groups are running right now
groups_none_declared: No script has declared a group kind

groups_note: A window, not a control panel - groups are made and broken by the scripts using them
groups_refused: You do not have access to this page
groups_wip_help: The group system works and is ready to build on. No script on this server has declared a kind yet, so this page will stay empty until one does.
help_access_note: Who can open this menu, and how to let them.

help_studio_note: Search, presets, and placing things in the world.
help_support_copied: Copied -- paste it into Discord and it lands as a file

help_support_failed: Nothing copied -- open it and copy from there

help_waypoints_note: The world markers every script draws.
home_owns_all: You are running every GG script

logs_alert_target_bad: Paste the whole address, or just the id/token it ends with.
logs_alert_target_hint: full address or just the key
logs_types_empty: No script reports any activity yet.
minigame_memory_repeat: Click every tile that lit up
minigames_defaults_help: These are the built-in defaults. Pass any of them to change that call, nothing is stored.
minigames_help: The shared game set every GG script can call — try one, copy the call
minigames_keys_help: Pass keys as a table to ask for one per round — keys = { "E", "R", "T" }. Leave it out for E.
minigames_no_entry: Settings not loaded — is gg_lib fully started?
minigames_pick: Pick a game to try it and copy the call
outfit_leave_body: Keeping puts these clothes on the setting. Discarding puts back what was there when you opened it.
particles_more: Narrow the search to see the other
particles_none: Pick an effect to play it in front of you
particles_recentre: Move it to where you are standing
picker_hint_item: Or type an item name the inventory has not loaded yet
picker_hint_ped: Or type a custom ped model
scene_fly_hint: Left alt to fly · WASD · Space / Q · Shift
scene_standin: This scene carries no vehicle of its own - a stand-in is used
settings_action_capture: Photograph this row and use the result
settings_action_denied: You do not have permission to run this
settings_action_place: Set this up in the world
settings_action_tune: Build this look on a real vehicle
settings_bulk_hint: Paste vector4(x, y, z, heading) entries — separated by commas or new lines. vector3 and bare numbers work too.
settings_error_generic: Some changes could not be saved
settings_factory_reset_help: Restores every setting on this page to the value the script ships with, and deletes the stored overrides.
settings_model_missing: That model would not load on this server
settings_no_scripts: No scripts reported a settings panel
settings_ped_search: Search peds, or type a custom model…
settings_secret_stored: A value is stored — type to replace it
settings_server_only_help: Kept on the server. It can be replaced from here but never read back.
setup_failed: Could not save that -- check the server console.
setup_skip: Happy with these? Continue takes them as they are.

setup_step_theme_note: The accent every GG interface is built around. Pick one, or mix your own below.

sound_search: Search sounds, or a set name
updates_github: Opens the latest release on GitHub
util_more_matches: More matches than shown -- narrow the search

schema.label: Generic Settings
schema.general.language.label: Language
schema.general.language.help: What language Script Studio and every GG script speak. Anything a translation has not covered stays in English.
schema.general.currency_type.label: Currency
schema.general.currency_type.help: Default currency for every GG script.
schema.general.unit_system.label: Unit System
schema.general.unit_system.help: Which units every GG script shows distances and speeds in.
schema.general.number_format.label: Number Format
schema.general.number_format.help: How gg.util.formatNumber and formatMoney group digits in every GG script.
schema.interface.notifications.label: Notifications
schema.interface.notifications.help: Who draws gg.display.notify. Every GG script uses this one.
schema.interface.progressbar.label: Progress Bars
schema.interface.contextmenu.label: Context Menu
schema.interface.contextmenu.help: Who draws gg.menu -- menus, inputs and alerts.
schema.interface.textui.label: Text UI
schema.interface.textui.help: Who draws gg.display.DoTextui, the prompt shown near an interaction.
schema.interface.ox_progress_style.label: ox_lib Style
schema.interface.ox_progress_style.help: Which of ox_lib's two progress widgets to draw.
schema.interface.ox_progress_position.he: Where the circle sits. The bar is always along the bottom.
schema.interface.ox_textui_position.help: Which edge ox_lib anchors the prompt to.
schema.popup.position.label: Popup Anchor
schema.popup.panel_side.label: Job Panel Side
schema.popup.panel_side.help: Which edge of the screen the job panel sits against.
schema.popup.panel_height.label: Job Panel Height
schema.popup.panel_height.help: How far down that edge it sits. 0 is the top, 100 the bottom.
schema.debug.enabled.label: Debug Mode
schema.debug.enabled.help: Print what gg_lib is doing to the server console, and to F8 on the client. Takes effect immediately. Off on a live server.
schema.reset.daily_time.label: Daily Reset Time
schema.reset.daily_time.help: Time of day daily progress rolls over, on a 24 hour clock.
schema.reset.timezone.label: Reset Timezone
schema.reset.timezone.help: Which zone the reset time is measured in.
schema.waypoints.race.label: Race Checkpoint
schema.waypoints.race.help: The big countdown face, for checkpoints and finish lines.
schema.waypoints.taxi.label: Drop Off
schema.waypoints.taxi.help: The destination plate, for drop-offs, deliveries and pickups.
schema.items.image_url.label: Item Image Path
schema.items.image_url.help: Where item icons are served from, when the running inventory is not one gg_lib bridges. Put %s where the file name goes. Empty means use the detected inventory's own path.
schema.logs.retention_days.label: Keep History For
schema.logs.retention_days.help: Entries older than this are removed automatically.
schema.groups.general.label: General
schema.groups.interface.label: Interface
schema.groups.popup.label: Popups
schema.groups.reset.label: Daily Reset
schema.groups.waypoints.label: Waypoints
schema.groups.developer.label: Developer
schema.groups.logs.label: Logs
schema.groups.items.label: Items
schema.groups.bridge.label: Bridges
schema.theme.primary_color.label: Interface Accent Color
schema.theme.primary_color.help: The studio's accent color, and every other script's too once the toggle below is on.
schema.theme.apply_to_all.label: Apply Theme to All UIs
schema.theme.apply_to_all.help: On, every GG script paints its UI in the accent color above. Off, each script offers an accent color of its own and uses that instead.
schema.theme.fade_on_hover_out.label: Fade When Not Hovered
schema.theme.fade_on_hover_out.help: Panels fade back when the pointer leaves them, so the world behind can be checked without closing anything.
schema.theme.fade_opacity.label: Faded Opacity
schema.theme.fade_opacity.help: How visible a panel stays once it fades. 100 is no fade at all.
schema.screenshot.upload_key.label: Upload API Key
schema.screenshot.upload_key.help: Leave empty to save images into the script's own web folder instead of uploading them. Stored on the server only -- once set it is never sent back out, so it can be replaced but not read.
schema.screenshot.location.label: Capture Spot
schema.screenshot.location.help: Where vehicles are spawned to be photographed. Somewhere flat, empty and far from players.
schema.actions.retention_days.label: Keep Action History For
schema.actions.retention_days.help: Recorded actions older than this are removed automatically.
schema.actions.webhook_name.label: Webhook Name
schema.actions.webhook_name.help: The name every action webhook posts under.
schema.actions.webhook_avatar.label: Webhook Avatar
schema.actions.webhook_avatar.help: Image the webhook posts with. Leave empty for none.
schema.groups.appearance.label: Appearance
schema.groups.screenshot.label: Screenshots
schema.groups.__updates__.label: Update Log
schema.settings.debug.label: Debug Mode
schema.settings.debug.help: Print what this script is doing to the server console, and to F8 on the client. Takes effect immediately -- no restart, and no file to edit.
schema.groups.developer.help: Console output for working out what this script is doing. Off on a live server.
